headline: Nigerian Government Releases Stranded Power Equipment Containers After 20 Years
summary: The Federal Government secured the release of 98 out of 300 transmission equipment containers that had been stranded at Nigerian ports for nearly two decades.
why: Upgrading transmission infrastructure is critical to reducing grid collapses and improving power supply reliability for industrial and commercial sectors in Nigeria.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Clearing transmission equipment helps address power infrastructure bottlenecks, supporting long-term economic productivity.
